_comment: Claude Code template; GitHub Copilot's equivalent is under .github/templates.

_verified.primeng: @primeng/mcp is published on npm (verified 2026-11); its README documents `npx -y @primeng/mcp` as the public command and `claude mcp add primeng -- npx -y @primeng/mcp` for Claude Code
_verified.angular-cli: VERIFIED 2026-11 — `@angular/cli` ships a built-in `mcp` subcommand (`ng mcp`), so `npx -y @angular/cli mcp` is a valid stdio entry (NEW-side docs + build/devserver validation, BOTH targets). In a real project pass `--root <abs-path-to-project>`.
_verified.tailwind: Remote/URL MCP at https://mcp.tailwind.ai (Tailwind's official MCP, BOTH targets for PrimeFlex->Tailwind). Config is {"tailwind":{"url":"https://mcp.tailwind.ai"}} — a remote HTTP server, NOT an npx stdio entry. Verify at Gate 3 by listing mcp__tailwind__* tools. Companion skills: `npx @tailwind-app/skills`.
_verified.ngm-dev-blocks: Material target ONLY — VERIFIED 2026-11 — the dedicated Angular Material generator from ui.angular-material.dev/docs/mcp. `npx -y @ngm-dev/cli mcp <abs-project-dir>` exposes get-all-block-names / generate-angular-material-block / setup-angular-material-blocks. Complements angular-cli (generator writes the new Material+Tailwind code; angular-cli validates it). NOT used for the Optimus target.

ngm-dev-blocks._comment: Material blocks; replace path with workspace path, or '.' at its root.
